The user went there on their birthday in March and had a delicious main course, but when they returned a month later, that same main course was gone. They want to know which one it was, using the Wayback Machine.

First, I need to understand how the Wayback Machine works. It's an archive of the web, so I can look up specific snapshots of a website on a particular date. The URLs provided by the assistant were for March 22 and April 21, 2021. The assistant tried to use Python scripts to scrape the menus, but there was a connection error. That's a problem because if the scripts aren't working, the assistant can't automatically extract the menu items.

So, the assistant then manually checked the Wayback Machine snapshots by going to those URLs. On April 21, the menu had Roast Chicken, Grilled Salmon, Beef Short Ribs, and Vegetarian Plate. The only difference is that Shrimp and Grits was on the March menu but not on the April menu.

But wait, the user mentioned that the main course they had was delicious, but it's not clear which one it was. However, based on the comparison, Shrimp and Grits was the only main course that changed. So, that's likely the one the user had.
